notes: Sister property to Salt Lick Safari Lodge (same operator/contract document, same overall T&Cs) - see salt-lick-safari-lodge-2026.json for shared policies (group discounts, tour leader, agent/FAM rates, day room, walk-in meals, cancellation).
59 Resort Rooms + 2 Executive Suites, each with a private viewing balcony. Historic WWI-era stone building with onsite museum.
Unlike Salt Lick, children under 4 ARE welcome here (free when sharing with adults) - no age-based exclusion.

childPolicy.raw: Infant to 4yrs sharing with 1-2 adults: free. 5-11.99yrs sharing with 1-2 adults: 50% of adult sharing rate (max 3 guests/room). 5-11.99yrs own room (min 2, max 3): 75% of adult sharing rate. Suites: max 2 adults + 1 child.

occupancyRules.raw: Max 3 adults, or 2 adults + 1 child. Triple rooms subject to availability. Interconnecting rooms ARE available here (unlike Salt Lick).

sanctuaryEntryFee.raw: Does NOT apply for stays at Taita Hills Safari Resort & Spa unless guests enter the sanctuary for game activities (in which case US$40/adult, US$20/child/night applies).

madarakaExpressTrainPackage_2026.roomCategory: Park View Rooms only (no Waterhole View category at this property)
extraNightPackageIncludes: Visit to Taita Hills Wildlife Education Centre
madarakaExpressTrainPackage_2026.childPolicyNote: Infants to age 4 free of charge sharing with 1-2 adults (train tickets payable if applicable) - notably more lenient than Salt Lick's under-5 exclusion.

policies.deposit: Full payment 30 days prior to arrival; cheques not accepted
policies.cancellation: 30-16 days: 25% loss; 15-8 days: 50% loss; 7 days-arrival: 100% loss
policies.sharedGroupTermsNote: Group discounts, tour leader policy, agent/FAM rates, day room policy, walk-in meal rates, half board reduction identical to Salt Lick Safari Lodge - see salt-lick-safari-lodge-2026.json.
